requirement: Every input’s contents must equal its selected UTF-8 lines exactly, including Unicode, LF versus CRLF, and presence or absence of the final newline.
justification: Scenarios: Unicode, CRLF versus LF, missing final newline, edited/shifted selected lines, deleted files, and changes only outside excerpts. The snapshot preserves bytes of UTF-8 line slices and comparison is exact. Tests show cited changes fail and uncited-only changes remain valid, which accurately bounds what the checker certifies. Validated with cargo test --locked --offline --manifest-path language-lab-ci/Cargo.toml (20 tests passing). Each cited test uses isolated fixture files and asserts outcomes, not merely the presence of instructions. Reviewed the cited assertions after the test edit: their code is byte-identical; only line positions moved, with no behavioral change. All 21 checker tests passed with cargo test --locked --offline --manifest-path language-lab-ci/Cargo.toml.
